item.vplus.family.machete.desc: One-handed slash. The sweep deals half the main hit.
item.vplus.family.shortsword.desc: Light finesse pierce. Can be dual-wielded with another light weapon; the offhand deals half damage.
item.vplus.family.rapier.desc: Finesse pierce. Can be used with a shield. Blocking removes the finesse attack speed.
item.vplus.family.hammer.desc: One-handed blunt. With an empty offhand it is gripped in two hands: more damage, slower swings.
item.vplus.family.throwing_axe.desc: Light slash. Can be thrown. Full damage up close, less at range, and it can be picked up.
item.vplus.family.throwing_knife.desc: Stackable light piercing knife. Thrown knives are not recovered. Stacks cannot take an affix.
item.vplus.family.buckler.desc: Light shield. A narrower block arc, faster to raise, and a lighter movement penalty.
item.vplus.family.medium_shield.desc: Standard shield. Protection, block arc, and handling match the vanilla shield.
item.vplus.family.tower_shield.desc: Heavy shield. A wider block arc, slower to raise, and a heavier movement penalty.
item.vplus.family.gauntlet.desc: Light blunt with very short reach. Can be dual-wielded.
item.vplus.family.katana.desc: Two-handed slash with a quick swing. No sweep, and the offhand cannot block.
item.vplus.family.dart.desc: Throwable piercing pole. Full damage up close, and it can be stuck in the ground and picked up.
item.vplus.family.great_hammer.desc: Heavy two-handed blunt. Can break shields and knock nearby enemies back. Slows movement while held.
item.vplus.family.flail.desc: Heavy two-handed blunt with longer reach. Slows movement while held.
item.vplus.family.heavy_shield.desc: Two-handed heavy shield. The block arc covers the front and movement is very slow. A shield bash deals no damage.
item.vplus.unique_knife.desc: Made from four iron throwing knives and string. Can take an affix and gems. Thrown knives are not recovered and cannot be Loyal.
item.vplus.pauldron.desc: While blocking, the block arc gains 10 degrees and the shield-disable time is 0.5 seconds shorter. Adds no armor.
item.vplus.lining.desc: Worn with a chestplate. Melee damage taken is reduced by 1 more. Adds no armor and does not count as wearing armor.
item.vplus.belt.desc: When worn, adds a slot on each hip for a medium weapon, medium shield, or lantern. Press Z to swap with the main hand; sneak swaps the other side.
item.vplus.shoulder_strap.desc: When worn, adds a slot under each arm for a small weapon, buckler, or lantern. Press X to swap with the main hand; sneak swaps the other side.
item.vplus.back_strap.desc: When worn, adds a back slot for a heavy weapon, tower shield, heavy shield, or lantern. Press C to swap with the main hand.
item.vplus.quiver.desc: In the inventory or hotbar, opens four arrow slots: arrows, tipped arrows, spectral arrows, and firework rockets. Bows do not use rockets.
item.vplus.potion_bag.desc: In the inventory or hotbar, opens four potion slots for potions, splash potions, and lingering potions. They are not drunk automatically.
item.vplus.tasty_bread.desc: Bread baked a second time in a furnace. Restores 5 hunger with more saturation than bread.
item.vplus.enchanted_copper.desc: A copper ingot smelted in a blast furnace. Recasts a weapon affix. Being enchanted raises the chance of a high-tier affix.
item.vplus.enchanted_iron.desc: An iron ingot smelted in a blast furnace. Recasts a weapon affix. Being enchanted raises the chance of a high-tier affix.
item.vplus.enchanted_gold.desc: A gold ingot smelted in a blast furnace. Recasts a weapon affix. Being enchanted raises the chance of high-tier and rainbow affixes.
item.vplus.enchanted_netherite.desc: A netherite ingot smelted in a blast furnace. Recasting is most likely to roll a high-tier or rainbow affix.
item.vplus.technique_bash.desc: Fits a shield. Tap use to bash the enemy in front. Cooldown depends on the shield's size.
item.vplus.technique_burst.desc: Fits a shield. A successful block bursts outward and knocks nearby enemies away. Cooldown: 3 seconds.
item.vplus.technique_fan.desc: Fits a sword, machete, axe, katana, or hoe. Tap use to swing an arc. Cooldown: 3 seconds.
item.vplus.technique_lunge.desc: Fits a rapier, shortsword, or pickaxe. Tap use to stab the first enemy ahead. Cooldown: 2.5 seconds.
item.vplus.technique_stomp.desc: Fits a hammer, shovel, gauntlet, or heavy weapon. Tap use to stomp and knock nearby enemies away. Cooldown: 3.5 seconds.
item.vplus.mold_light.desc: Used up at a smithing table to socket a shortsword, gauntlet, throwing knife, throwing axe, or hoe. Costs one copper ingot.
item.vplus.mold_one.desc: Used up at a smithing table to socket a one-handed weapon that is not light. Costs one copper ingot.
item.vplus.mold_two.desc: Used up at a smithing table to socket a two-handed or heavy weapon, bow, or crossbow. Costs one copper ingot.
item.vplus.mold_shield.desc: Used up at a smithing table to socket any shield. Costs one copper ingot.
item.vplus.mold_extra.desc: Used up at a smithing table to raise a weapon from one socket to two.

item.vplus.shepherd_pattern.desc: Cannot be worn. Sneak and use it on a loom with four wool. After two seconds it weaves clothing. A shepherd pattern accepts wool of any color, and the result is dyed that color.
